name: manual_b3ca92
claim: Keep CLI crash diagnostics safe by default. Opt-in verbose output may expose traceback frame locations and symbols, but not exception messages, source lines, local variables or full workstation paths. On legacy consoles use backslashreplace for identifiers so an unencodable model ID is recoverable rather than replaced by question marks.
